name: scheduling
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when scheduling moves to a different clock source (e.g. a native plugin cron API) or when the tick interval/route become config-driven and this slice's hardcoding is removed.
spec_change_reason: Consume verify-integrate's new reconcile_result.auto_merged (a List of {pr_ref, issue_ref} — acted_ledger PRs RECONCILE detected MERGED this tick, i.e. an auto-merge GitHub completed asynchronously BETWEEN ticks). (1) run_tick's tick_end event detail now carries auto_merged=len(reconcile_result.auto_merged) + auto_merged_refs (the merged pr_refs), mirroring the deduped count, and the one-line trace gains a compact auto_merged=<n> token shown only when >0. (2) _persist_reconcile_outcome stamps each acted_ledger entry named in reconcile_result.auto_merged to a TERMINAL outcome='merged' (applied before the closed_issues stamp so a both-case ends terminal as 'closed'), so _reconcile_ledger_seed (seeds only outcome=='opened') never re-seeds it — the completion is surfaced in tick_end.auto_merged EXACTLY ONCE. scheduling only CONSUMES the field + stamps the ledger; verify-integrate owns the Reconcile logic (separate cycle, same wave). Re-anchored the housekeep spec.md baseline 1420->1435 for the already-committed 0.43.0 spec growth (contract.md kept under its strictly-grew gate). Cross-feature contract: the field is exactly auto_merged, entries {pr_ref, issue_ref}.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md was already updated to 0.44.0 during cycle prep (make_reconcile canonical pr_ref + PRIOR_VERDICTS_KEY snapshot); this cycle lands the code, tests, feature.json version bump, and baseline re-anchor
